title: Draw Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🖍️draw plugin's 7-crate constitutional layout (🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact, 🎛️apps/🖍️draw/⚡️implementations, 🎛️apps/🖍️draw/🔨️modules/{🔄️fsm,🔧️op,🎒️pack,📡️protocol,🗣️dsl,🖱️ui,⚙️engine}) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-draw` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🖍️draw/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy tree (🗿️artifacts/<a>/{🔺️diff,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,🔧️op,📡️spr,⚙️engine}, 🎛️apps/<app>/{🦀️component.rs,🦀️config.rs,🦀️terminology.rs,🎮️commands/*,🎭️modes/*}), following TEMPLATE.md's exact ordered checklist (26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md). Preserve every [package.metadata.*] table verbatim from the old bundle crate. Fix the pre-existing systemic 'unclosed Ok(' corruption in the old ui crate's lib.rs as a natural side effect of porting handle() into app_commands! handlers (9th confirmed instance of this repo-wide pattern, per master doc). Verify: cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test (wire-format byte-identical proof against baseline), then delete old crate manifests and report registrar handoff (root Cargo.toml lines to remove/add, workspace.dependencies changes, cross-plugin dependents found via Cargo.toml + use-line greps, especially dsl/fixture-sweep and dsl/registry). Do not touch root Cargo.toml, root script.ts, registry script, launch.json, any other plugin, or any AGENTS.md.
summary: Migrated 🖍️draw's 10-crate constitutional layout (bundle manifest + app facade + 6 module crates + fsm + fsm-macros) into 3 crates under Shape V2 taxonomy: semio-s-plugin-draw (main, single artifact "draw" + single app "draw" with edit mode/canvas window/3 panels/4 command groups), semio-s-plugin-draw-fsm, and semio-s-plugin-draw-fsm-macros (kept as 2 separate crates from the main one — a proc-macro crate can never be merged into a normal rlib/cdylib crate, so this is the plugin's own genuine reusable statechart library + its macro sibling, both moved to taxonomy-clean 📦️packages/🦀️rust paths). Fixed the pre-existing systemic 'unclosed Ok(' corruption in the old ui crate as a natural side effect of porting handle() into app_commands! handlers (9th confirmed repo-wide instance). Followed TEMPLATE.md's Shape V2 spec throughout (entry file inside 📦️packages/🦀️rust, config/terminology folded into their own 🎚️config/🗣️terminology component folders, orphan manifest.json relocated to plugin root as 🛂️manifest.json). All verification passed for all 3 crates: cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test --lib (85/85 for main crate incl. full DrawCommand wire-guard suite with byte-pinned hex proof for Option-field rows + all 63 old-crate tests preserved/exceeded; 26/26 fsm; 10/10 fsm-macros). Fixed the one real cross-cutting dependent (dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep Cargo.toml + use-line, repointed to the new crate/module path) — confirmed via full repo grep that no other file references any old draw crate name. Deleted all old crate directories and removed the temporary verification-only [workspace] overlays from all 3 new Cargo.toml files. Root Cargo.toml, registry, launch.json, and any other plugin were not touched (registrar's job, handoff details in the ticket-close report to the orchestrator).
